title: Blocksy vs Kadence
description: A documentation-led comparison of Blocksy’s Customizer-first controls and Kadence’s visual header, footer, and global design workflow.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped Blocksy versus Kadence WordPress comparison from KreativWP.
comparisonAreas: Customizer-first controls versus visual header and footer builders
Global color, typography, and layout settings
Documented ecommerce and page-level layout workflow
Same-content performance, accessibility, and support tests still required
takeaway: Blocksy is a sensible research path for site builders who prefer many presentation controls in a familiar Customizer workflow. Kadence deserves attention when visual header, footer, and global-design controls are central to the build.

decisionGuide.chooseLeft: a Customizer-led workflow and page-level layout overrides are familiar to the person maintaining the site.
decisionGuide.chooseRight: the team wants visual header and footer control alongside centrally managed palette, typography, and layout settings.
decisionGuide.verify: Recreate your navigation, one product or landing page, and the mobile states before deciding. Confirm the feature and plan boundaries for your use case.
